title: Hayati Pro Ultra Plus 25K Fruit Bomb & Straw Watermelon B Gum Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Hayati Pro Ultra Plus 25k Fruit Bomb & Straw' Watermelon B' Gum Prefilled Pod + Refill Overview Fruit Bomb & Straw' Watermelon B' Gum pairs a vibrant fruit punch with a classic candy profile. Twist between a rich, complex explosion of mixed berries and tropical fruits, and a nostalgic, sweet blend of juicy strawberry and watermelon infused into a smooth bubblegum base. Designed for use with the Hayati Ultra 25K Prefilled Pod Kit, this format pairs a 2ml prefilled pod with two 10ml auto-refilling containers so you can enjoy long-range performance without manual refills or coil changes. The integrated mesh coil and 20mg Nic Salt provide defined flavour, smooth MTL vapour and quick nicotine satisfaction. Find your next favourite flavour: Explore all Hayati Pro Ultra Plus 25000 Refill Pods How to Set Up Hayati Pro Ultra Plus 25K Pods Step 1 Remove all protective seals from the 2ml pod and both 10ml refill containers. Step 2 Click the 2ml pod into the mouthpiece module. Step 3 Align and click up to two 10ml auto-refilling containers into the mouthpiece. Step 4 Insert the assembled unit into the device. Step 5 Allow a short moment for the coil to saturate before vaping. ✅ You're all set!
